title: client_config.kids
description: Kids mode of a device with parental controls. Present exactly when profile.child_protection is true. The hub enforces the rules where it is reachable, the integration (<ns>.control) when away is ha; rules is for display (grey out, limit sliders, countdown). rules.profile mirrors the effective kids_* rules (client_config.rules), rules.areas and rules.entities the profile's kids_exceptions with the own area resolved.

control.description: Control path at home: only through the hub (WS control).

away.description: How the device controls while the hub is not reachable. none = not at all (no HA key on the device, ha_token null: rule control_path hub without remote access). ha = the device holds a read-only HA key (rule control_path checked, or hub with effective remote_access; ha_token while the access is open, ha_enforcement.control_path checked) and, while the hub is not reachable, reads states and history from Home Assistant and switches only through <ns>.control, where the integration enforces every kids rule (bedtime, blocked types, color lock, volume cap, releases; pauses and the pause of everything asked from the hub, kids-check). Requests (“Can I have more time?”) go through <ns>/family. Where the hub is reachable it stays the control path.

time_zone.description: IANA zone of the bedtime windows (Home Assistant's time_zone); null = UTC.

override_until.description: Parent release: until then bedtime, rate limit and pauses do not apply (blocked types, color lock and volume cap do). null = no release.

paused_all_until.description: Everything is paused until then (overall rate limit kids_rate_limit_all exceeded); the hub rejects every action with rule_blocked {reason paused_all, until}. The app may grey out all controls and show the end time; it switches back at until even offline. Missing or null = no pause of everything. The hub sends client_config_updated when such a pause starts or is ended early (release, admin).

releases.description: Running releases by the admin or a family manager; the app shows them (“Up until 21:00”) and switches back at until even offline. Missing = none.
